estimates.anchor_source: No market prices this. Designated anchor: the programme's registered live FX object, fx-lag-v2 H2 (Phi on disclosed ADR-FX) PIT point +1.85 for 3Q26 at the 6 Aug 2026 guide date, with the Phi x 0.653 shape-scale +2.2; the 1.85-2.2 cluster at +-0.7pp through the letter-rounding kernel.
estimates.divergence_justification: management's guided FX integer printed at or above the guided figure in 9 of 10 pairs (both 'approximately three' guides printed 3 and 4); the registered spec under-forecast the last two prints by ~1pp; the lag-loaded kernel at the free fit's scale reproduces the guide (+2.9) on the basket refreshed to 11 Sep

model.structure: mixture of after-hedge revenue-FX constructions, each ~N(centre, sd), mapped to the letter integer by round(g+f) - round(g) with g the ex-FX growth (fractional part uniform); x 0.98, plus 0.02 not stated
